statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r equals the number of pairs of integers (i, j) such that 0 <= i <= j < len(nums) and left <= max(nums[i], ..., nums[j]) <= right, where max(nums[i], ..., nums[j]) denotes the maximum of the non-empty contiguous subarray nums[i], nums[i+1], ..., nums[j].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; 0 <= left <= right <= 10^9; and the number of qualifying subarrays is at most 2^31 - 1.

statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail, panic, overflow, or access memory out of bounds) for every input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; 0 <= left <= right <= 10^9; and the number of qualifying subarrays is at most 2^31 - 1.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r >= 0.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; 0 <= left <= right <= 10^9; and the number of qualifying subarrays is at most 2^31 - 1.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r <= len(nums) * (len(nums) + 1) / 2.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; 0 <= left <= right <= 10^9; and the number of qualifying subarrays is at most 2^31 - 1.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = len(nums) * (len(nums) + 1) / 2.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), left <= nums[i] <= right; 0 <= left <= right <= 10^9; and the number of qualifying subarrays is at most 2^31 - 1.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = 0.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] < left or nums[i] > right; 0 <= left <= right <= 10^9; and the number of qualifying subarrays is at most 2^31 - 1.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r > 0 if and only if there exists an index i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and left <= nums[i] <= right.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; 0 <= left <= right <= 10^9; and the number of qualifying subarrays is at most 2^31 - 1.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is at least the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and left <= nums[i] <= right.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; 0 <= left <= right <= 10^9; and the number of qualifying subarrays is at most 2^31 - 1.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = 1 if left <= nums[0] <= right, and r = 0 otherwise.
preconditions: len(nums) = 1; 0 <= nums[0] <= 10^9; 0 <= left <= right <= 10^9; and the number of qualifying subarrays is at most 2^31 - 1.

statement: Define, for any integer t, C(t) as the number of pairs (i, j) with 0 <= i <= j < len(nums) and max(nums[i], ..., nums[j]) <= t, where max(nums[i], ..., nums[j]) is the maximum of the non-empty subarray nums[i], ..., nums[j]. Whenever the function returns a result r, r = C(right) - C(left - 1).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; 0 <= left <= right <= 10^9; and the number of qualifying subarrays is at most 2^31 - 1.

statement: Whenever the function returns r1 on input (nums, left, right1) and r2 on input (nums, left, right2), r1 <= r2.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; 0 <= left <= right1 <= right2 <= 10^9; and the qualifying counts for (nums,left,right1) and (nums,left,right2) are each at most 2^31 - 1.

statement: Whenever the function returns r1 on input (nums, left1, right) and r2 on input (nums, left2, right), r2 <= r1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9; 0 <= left1 <= left2 <= right <= 10^9; and the qualifying counts for (nums,left1,right) and (nums,left2,right) are each at most 2^31 - 1.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r on input (nums, left, right) and a result r' on input (nums', left, right), r = r'.
preconditions: len(nums) = len(nums') = n with 1 <= n <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= nums[i] <= 10^9 and 0 <= nums'[i] <= 10^9; 0 <= left <= right <= 10^9; for every i, nums[i] and nums'[i] have the same three-way relation to [left, right] (both are < left, both are in [left, right], or both are > right); and the qualifying counts for both (nums,left,right) and (nums',left,right) are at most 2^31 - 1.
